Zoll, disguised as Harper Leistine, is a Doppelganger posing as a lightfoot halfling member of the Harpers. Originally on a mission to look into Bhaalist activity in the city and to find the whereabouts of the Mad Rashemaar, Leistine was killed and impersonated some time ago.

History

Bhaalist Resurgence

After rumors of Bhaalist activity surfaced in Baldur's Gate,  Jaheira ordered her Harpers to look into the machinations of the Cult of Bhaal, letting them uncover as much information as possible while she led another force of Harpers into the Shadow-Cursed Lands to defeat  Ketheric Thorm. However, as Jaheira ordered the Harpers to concentrate their efforts in finding the  Rashemaar, Leistine and her cell of Harpers were either killed or captured, only to be brought to  Orin.

The sole survivor of the Harper cell, a raw recruit by the name of  Geraldus, would be used a live bait for Jaheira and the party to contact, in an attempt to ambush and silence them[1].

Involvement

Bhaalist Ambush

While in Wyrm's Crossing following ⁠The High Harper with Jaheira, she points out Danthelon's Dancing Axe, a store run by  Entharl Danthelon, and front for a Harper safe house. In a secret room beneath the store, an impersonated Leistine,  Chelvin,  Leysin, and  Thonos wait to ambush Jaheira and the party.

Upon the party and Jaheira's arrival, Geraldus attempts to communicate through use of an old Harper code that the Harpers present are traitors. If present in the party, Jaheira understands the code. She mentions the impersonated Chelvin seems familiar and reminds her of  Marcus. Failing to recognize the code starts combat with the party  Surprised, while recognizing and acting on it surprises the impersonated Harpers.

Notes

  • The impersonated Harpers all share the same doppelganger stat block, but there are stats in the game files for a non-impersonated version of Leysin that is completely inaccessible in-game.
    • The doppelganger form reverts it back to 9m of movement.
    • The doppelganger form weighs 65 kg.
    • The original version of Leistine had 15 STR, 14 DEX, 12 CON, 12 INT, 10 WIS, and 12 CHA; however, she had a ranged archetype, halfling racial features, and no melee/ranged class features or equipment.
  • Leistine's portrait does not resemble her model's appearance. Her model features dark skin, and raised black curly hair, while her portrait depicts a cool skin tone, and shorter brown hair.
